parties: Ravindra Energy Limited (rights issue); Care Ratings Limited (Monitoring Agency)
headline: Ravindra Energy Limited files Q1 FY2026-27 Monitoring Agency Report on rights issue
sum: Ravindra Energy Limited submitted its Q1 FY2026-27 Monitoring Agency Report via Care Ratings Limited, documenting compliance with rights issue conditions and fund deployment under SEBI regulations.
implication: Rights issues require continuous monitoring agency reporting under SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2018; the Q1 filing confirms the company is in active deployment phase with quarterly disclosure obligations to the exchange.
detail: The Monitoring Agency Report (MA Report) is a mandatory quarterly filing under SEBI's capital issuance framework for rights offerings. Care Ratings Limited, the appointed Monitoring Agency, certifies the company's adherence to fund-utilisation timelines, reserve requirements, and disclosure obligations. The Q1 FY2026-27 submission (filed 14 Aug 2026) indicates the rights issue was live during FY2025-26 or earlier FY2026-27, with monies received subject to time-bound deployment schedules. No deviation report or stock exchange approval delay is flagged, suggesting routine compliance.
